title: Um botão, um campo: escrever ou pedir · toda tarefa tem subtarefas

screens.title: 1 · Plano, um botão só
screens.why: The ask bar and the + become one button: the crescent with a plus.

pins.label: Lua com +
pins.text: AppIcons.compose: the brand's crescent with a plus in its hollow, one colour (onAccent) on the accent circle, 30 px in the 56 px AppFab. SVG on the 64 grid in app/brands/<brand>/compose.svg.

pins.label: Sem barra do agente
pins.text: AskDock's bar is gone from every tab and page. The button sits where the + was (AppFab.location, bottom right, thumb side), the same on every screen.

screens.title: 2 · Falar
screens.why: One field: type, or tap the mic and the words rise in it.

pins.label: Um campo
pins.text: Hint: "Uma tarefa, um evento, ou o que mudar no dia". No Tarefa | Evento, no hour or length pills: they are read from the words.

pins.label: ↑ envia
pins.text: Recording reuses VoiceBar (trash, time, wave); its stop is ↑ and sends at once. Typed, the mic sits left and ↑ right, grey until there is text.

screens.title: 3 · Lido como evento
screens.why: A small box over the sheet says what will be written, before anything is.

pins.label: O tipo
pins.text: Pin on fixedFill for an Evento, check for a Tarefa, the crescent for changes to the day. While reading: a spinner and "Entendendo…" in the same box.

pins.label: Uma linha
pins.text: Kind · day, hour (or "na fila") · length. A single task or event must come back in about a second: a small, fast read, not the agent's turn.

pins.label: Adicionar
pins.text: The one accent action: writes it through the same routes as the old sheet, closes the sheet, Desfazer on the snackbar.

pins.label: Ajustar
pins.text: Opens the old detailed sheet (AppPromptSheet) filled with what was read, for a fix by hand.

pins.label: O texto fica
pins.text: The field keeps the words: change one and send again, and the box is read again.

screens.title: 4 · Tarefa com subtarefas
screens.why: Every task can hold tasks: said in one breath, written in one tap.

pins.label: Em qual tarefa
pins.text: "pro post de Touro" is matched to an open task: the new one goes under it (AppTag "em …"). One level: a subtask has none.

pins.label: Subtarefas
pins.text: A list after a colon, or "primeiro… depois…", becomes its subtasks, in order. Adicionar writes the task and them together.

screens.title: 5 · Um pedido maior
screens.why: Not one thing to add but a change to the day: the agent's plan, shortened.

pins.label: É o agente
pins.text: The crescent marks a plan. This is the only case that takes the agent's whole turn; the box says "Entendendo…" longer, and nothing else changes.

pins.label: As mudanças
pins.text: The plan card's lines (PlanLine), up to four; more open the conversation.

pins.label: Conversar
pins.text: Opens the full conversation page on this turn, where Ajustar and Desfazer already live.

pins.label: Aplicar
pins.text: Applies the plan as the plan card does, with its undo.
